implementation: Owned File consumed/rewound; regular current-owner private single-link signed length checks before reads; exact hash and stable held metadata including mutation timestamps before certification. Existing path API retains ancestors/name/no-follow/inode guards; O_NONBLOCK avoids FIFO substitution blocking. Same chunk/deadline/quota/certification path; no arbitrary Read. Six new units cover offset/output equivalence, pinned descriptor path with independent path refusal/name replacement, initial unsafe metadata, changed metadata after reads, hash/community/budgets/invalid deadlines, actual expired shared lane. Owner mismatch uses metadata-validator expectedUID test without privileged chown. Caller scheduling cannot restart the real deadline.
scope: two-file trusted owned checkpoint File API and shared guarded chunker, no runtime/server wiring
